title: Traditional British Pork Pie
description: A classic British dish made with slow-cooked pork and a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Roll out pie dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large skillet, cook the pork over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and mushrooms to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Stir in the brown gravy and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the pork mixture to the pie crust.
Roll out the remaining pie dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use the dough to cover the pie and crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let the pie rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
